brief:
Israeli forces conducted raids across the occupied West Bank beginning late Monday, storming homes and detaining at least three Palestinian men, Middle East Eye reported. Local sources provided accounts of the operations, which targeted multiple locations throughout the territory.

The raids were part of ongoing Israeli military activity in the West Bank, where such operations have become routine. Details on the identities of those detained and the stated purpose of the operations were not immediately available.
